thread:
Alex: opening idea: "local reads, escrowed writes". we issue short-lived escrow tokens from regional control plane. token = residency=eu;exp=167...;sig=... (signed by HSM)

Devon: quick ask — what guarantees do tokens provide?

Alex: they assert that a write is authorized to be handled in the resident region. verification happens at the edge -> if valid, forward to resident write gateway. if invalid/expired, we choose one of: immediate legal-deny (451), transient block (503), or best-effort route to non-resident with audit. decision per-tenant.

Maria: header proposal: X-Residency-Escrow: residency=eu;token=eyJ... ;client-sig=...

Carla: tokens introduce infra dependency. control-plane outage -> no new tokens -> writes stall. mitigation?

Alex: SDK will pre-acquire tokens and auto-renew with overlap. also support a fallback signing key for emergency mode that still logs stronger audit trail.

SRE_June: ops: please standardize error codes: 451 for legal/residency rejection, 503 for gateway/unreachable, 409 for conflict. makes handling deterministic.

ops-bot: runbook note: signing keys live in HSM. rotate per-region quarterly. emergency-stash key requires 2-person ops approval.

Ben: telemetry hooks: trace tag residency.auth=escrow, counter escrow.issue.fail, escrow.validate.fail, hist stream.renewal.latency.

Maria: sample curl:
```
POST /v1/tenants/123/completions
Authorization: Bearer <key>
X-Residency-Escrow: residency=eu;token=eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1Ni...
Body: {"prompt":"hello"}
```

Carla: testing: chaos plan
- kill regional leader
- rotate keys mid-flight
- expire tokens during active sessions
verify deterministic client errors and no silent fallthroughs.

SRE_June: alerting: if escrow.validate.fail >3% for 10m, flip tenant to read-only and fire page + annotate in incidents log. also enable canary fallback routing for <=1% transient spikes.

Ben: rollout: opt-in tenants. SDK call acquireEscrow(tenantId, region) with autoRenew default true. pilot EU bank customers first.

Alex: streaming consideration: add /v1/escrow/renew for mid-stream renewal. client must call before TTL/2. if renewal fails mid-stream, close with 451 and include residency_hint header so client can decide retry.

Devon: how to avoid token explosion? maintain per-device lease and allow batching renewals per SDK instance.

Maria: audit: every token issue recorded to append-only ledger signed by HSM key id. auditors can verify issuance chain.

Carla: security: token format should avoid embedding PII. only tenant-id, region, exp, key-id, nonce.

Alex: to-do: doc the token schema, edge validation algorithm, client SDK patterns, error mappings, test matrix. I'll open RFC and assign.

ops-bot: ticket created infra#4321 (escrow-writes-rfc) assigned Alex,Maria,Ben,Carla,SRE_June.

Alex: timeline: draft by EOW, review next Tue, pilot in two weeks. :thumbsup:
